nia: quick heads up 1: planning a short midnight window for a slim quant shim swap (abicode v3->v4 + int8-v3 flags). low-risk plan: 3% canary -> 20% -> 100% over ~90m. target 00:45-02:15 UTC. tagging night SRE.

raj: sounds good. do we have a checksum gate for the bundle? last time a staging node hit a mismatch and we had to pin.

nia: yes - preflight will run bundle-checksum across 5 staging shards. if any mismatch -> abort. also will run kv-cache warmup probe.

deploybot: [scheduled] release created: rb/quant-slim-shim-2026-03-22 (canary 3%). start=00:45 UTC. notify=#eng-runtime.

doc-writer: I can prep the blurb for release notes. need the short rollback bullets and fallback variant name.

raj: fallback variants: engine:compat-lite-2 for thermal, engine:compat-v1 for standard. rollback criteria: >4% request error increase OR p99 tail rise >200ms sustained for 5 minutes. additionally, if checksum failures observed, immediate abort.

nia: putting pin TTL=90m on canary so it auto-cleans. manual unpin window at 03:30 UTC if something lingers.

deploybot: command received: /release start rb/quant-slim-shim-2026-03-22 --canary=3 --ttl=90m --notify #eng-runtime

sre-oncall: I'm Sam. I'll monitor metrics and page for any SLO breaches. alert policy: error-rate >4% OR p99 latency delta >200ms -> PD.

raj: quick manual traffic shift snippet (in case we need to abort fast):
```
# emergency shift -> fallback
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/release/shift \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"release":"rb/quant-slim-shim-2026-03-22","to":0,"fallback":"engine:compat-v1"}'
```

doc-writer: draft note: "rb/quant-slim-shim-2026-03-22: ABI bump (v3->v4), quant=int8-v3, kv-cache warmup. Fallback: engine:compat-v1 / compat-lite-2. Rollback triggers: error-rate/p99 thresholds + checksum gate." will publish when you confirm checksum step.

nia: checksum preflight passed on all 5 staging shards at 00:30 UTC. smoke tests ok. proceeding with canary at 00:45.

deploybot: [running] canary started 00:45 UTC at 3%. metrics endpoint: /metrics/release/rb/quant-slim-shim-2026-03-22

sre-oncall: seeing baseline p95 bump of ~15ms at +4m. no errors. continuing to monitor.

raj: small note: routing policy updated to immediately route errors to engine:compat-lite-2 for thermal hosts. noisy customers should fall back quickly.

nia: if clean at +25m we go to 20%. otherwise hold and investigate.

doc-writer: published: https://docs.internal/releases/rb-quant-slim-shim-2026-03-22 1: cc: support, product.

deploybot: [status] promoted to 20% at 01:15 UTC.

sre-oncall: no PDs so far. brief p99 spike at +10m after 20% shift (220ms) but it resolved in 3m. marking as transient.

raj: recommend waiting 15m more then full promote if stable. also remember to clear canary pin after final rollout.

nia: agreed. final promote around 01:45 if no new signals. I'll post final build hash and update runbook.

deploybot: [info] automatic unpin set for 03:30 UTC.

sre-oncall: thanks everyone. will escalate immediately on policy breach.

nia: final: promote to 100% at 01:50 UTC. post-rollout chores: - clear canary pin - update runbook with hash - notify customers with breaking ABI details.

raj: I'll handle runbook update and paste hash when deploybot reports completed.

deploybot: [done] rollout completed at 01:52 UTC. build hash: sha256:9f8b7a6c3d4e2f1a0b9c6d5e4f3a2b1c.

nia: closing thread. all good from ops side. thanks :rocket:
